name: Rope Carousel
description: An infinite image carousel for React where photos hang from a curved rope: each card rides the catenary, leans with it and swings as its own pendulum, and the rope bounces when you throw it. Drag with momentum on mouse and touch, horizontal wheel or arrow keys. No dependencies; it sleeps when still or off screen.

props.name: items
props.type: {src: string; title?: string; caption?: string; href?: string}[]
props.description: The photos, with a title and caption on each print. With href, the card is a link. The line loops.

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Card width in px; scaled down on containers narrower than 1100px.

props.name: sag
props.description: How far the rope hangs in the middle, in px.

props.name: speed
props.description: Autoplay speed in px per second. 0 keeps the line still until it is dragged.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way autoplay moves the line.

props.name: sway
props.description: How much cards swing when the line speeds up, slows down or the pointer brushes them. 0 turns swinging off.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Stop autoplay while a mouse is over the carousel.

props.name: edgeFade
props.description: Width of the soft fade at both edges, in px. 0 turns it off.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
